query: In order to further exclude issues with recycling of transport mix components over time, we purified CAS (the protein responsible for shuttling Importinα back into the cytoplasm [Sun et al., 2013]) and tested its effect on the transport of a MS2S37P sample with 23 NLSs. As can be seen in panel B, including 1 µM CAS in the transport mix, no major differences in the capsid nuclear import were observed.
